statement: Exclude opponent claims from both first-round model inputs.
acceptance_metric: opponent fingerprint hits across both speaking orders

statement: Address only scheduler-selected claims in later rounds.
Validate claim_id, speaker, statement, evidence_ids, responds_to and unresolved_questions; enforce unique IDs and valid earlier non-self targets.
Validate every evidence ID against the evidence checker and the historical cutoff.
acceptance_metric: accepted invalid, unknown-time or future citations in strict mode
evidence_or_limit: S9 valid evidence IDs 30/30; strict snapshot binding needs A/C

statement: Allow one structural repair; preserve disagreements and a reason on persistent failure.
acceptance_metric: maximum repair calls per invalid output
evidence_or_limit: Offline repair paths; live repair no_sample

statement: Assemble identity, hard constraints, evidence, task, necessary history and resume state in fixed order.
Enforce the configured context budget and compact when the estimate exceeds the configured threshold.
acceptance_metric: accepted contexts above budget or missed threshold crossings

statement: Re-inject all hard constraints after compaction with identical multiplicities and text fingerprints.
acceptance_metric: hard constraint retention on every emitted context

statement: Deduplicate only by the documented text fingerprint.
acceptance_metric: distinct-fingerprint items merged or identical eligible items retained twice

statement: Require the manager to identify adopted arguments, reasons and unresolved disagreements, including in degraded results.
evidence_or_limit: S9 unresolved pairs retained 3/3; graph handoff pending

statement: Keep legacy behavior on identical recorded inputs.
acceptance_metric: legacy prompt or returned-state differences against pinned baseline
evidence_or_limit: S7 archived matched replay and legacy equivalence evidence

statement: Record usage provenance and granularity for every comparison.
acceptance_metric: measurements missing source or reported at unsupported granularity
evidence_or_limit: S9 estimated inputs 9/12; manager estimates unavailable
